html:
Built with Integrity,Delivered with QualityReliableSolutionFor Various Industries

At Rotozest, we pride ourselves on being one of the leading manufacturers and suppliers of high-quality Cast Iron (CI) and Stainless Steel (SS) rotary gear pumps. With a legacy of excellence and a commitment to precision, we serve industries with durable, reliable, and efficient pump solutions that enhance productivity and performance.

Founded with the vision of delivering top-notch pumping solutions, Rotozest is a name trusted by industries for its cutting-edge technology and robust products. Under the leadership of Hitesh Bhai Patel, Bharat Bhai Patel, and Raj Bhai Patel, we have consistently grown by offering innovative and efficient rotary gear pumps that cater to a variety of industrial applications.

Our dedication to superior quality, customer-centric service, and technological innovation makes us a preferred choice in the market. Whether you require pumps for transferring viscous fluids, oil, or chemicals, we have the solution tailored to your needs.

Our Products

SS Rotary Gear Pumps

Our Stainless Steel (SS) rotary gear pumps are corrosion-resistant, making them ideal for industries requiring hygiene and precision. These pumps are perfect for applications involving corrosive fluids, chemicals, and food-grade materials, ensuring longevity and reliability.

Read More

CI Rotary Gear Pumps

Known for their excellent performance and durability, our Cast Iron (CI) rotary gear pumps are designed for a wide range of applications. They provide efficient, reliable, and cost-effective solutions for industries handling oils, syrups, and viscous liquids.

Each pump we manufacture undergoes rigorous quality checks to ensure superior performance and durability, meeting the highest industry standards.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

faq.q: What products does Rotozest offer as a rotary gear pump manufacturer?
faq.a: Rotozest is a reputed rotary gear pump manufacturer offering both Cast Iron (CI) and Stainless Steel (SS) rotary gear pumps. These pumps are engineered for precise, efficient fluid transfer in industries like chemical processing, food and beverage, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and more.

faq.q: Why should I choose Rotozest as my rotary gear pump supplier in all India?
faq.a: As a trusted rotary gear pump supplier in all India, Rotozest combines industry-grade materials, advanced manufacturing, and extensive quality checks to ensure durable performance. Our customer-centric support and on-time delivery make us a preferred choice across Indian industries and beyond.

faq.q: Where is Rotozest located and do they offer a rotary gear pump in Ahmedabad?
faq.a: Yes - Rotozest manufactures and supplies a high-quality rotary gear pump in Ahmedabad as well as across the country. Our facility in Ahmedabad enables rapid support and distribution to industrial clients throughout Gujarat and India.

faq.q: What industries use Rotozest rotary gear pumps?
faq.a: Rotozest’s rotary gear pumps are widely used in industries such as oil & gas, chemical processing, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, agriculture, paints & dyes, and more due to their reliability in handling viscous and sensitive fluids.

faq.q: How do rotary gear pumps from Rotozest work?
faq.a: Rotary gear pumps are positive-displacement pumps that transfer fluid through the meshing action of gears. This design ensures a smooth flow, excellent suction capability, and consistent performance even with high-viscosity liquids.

faq.q: Can I get customized solutions from Rotozest as a industrial rotary gear pump manufacturer?
faq.a: Yes - Rotozest offers customization of industrial rotary gear pumps based on your specific application needs, materials, and operating conditions to ensure optimal performance and reliability.

faq.q: Is Rotozest a trusted gear pump supplier in all India for export and domestic needs?
faq.a: Absolutely. Rotozest serves as a leading gear pump supplier in all India, delivering high-quality rotary gear pump solutions to industrial clients nationwide and supporting international requirements with reliable products and service.

faq.q: What types of fluids can Rotozest rotary gear pumps handle?
faq.a: Rotozest rotary gear pumps are designed to handle a wide range of fluids - from viscous oils and syrups to corrosive chemicals and food-grade liquids - making them highly versatile for multiple industrial processes.

faq.q: How do I request a quote from the rotary gear pump supplier in all India?
faq.a: You can request a quote by contacting Rotozest directly through the website contact form or by reaching out via phone or email for detailed pricing and specifications tailored to your application needs.
